items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Walter Delarue was playing sax. I was playing the piano. And George Augustine... and Rennie playing trumpet.

ctx.x: Did you have different drums with Rene, or did you always use Joe Rene?
Joe Rene always played with his brother.
Yeah, I see. How long did you play with him? Oh, about two years or three years or something. Just in one place where you-
